summary: Land encroachment dispute; concurrent findings of ownership and encroachment upheld; Section 51 Transfer of Property Act not applicable as appellant failed to prove transferee status, bona fide belief, or adverse possession; estoppel defense rejected; demolition of structures and possession recovery ordered restored; no independent appeal filed by appellant against first appellate decree; final judgment in favor of respondent for land possession.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment restoring Trial Court decree for demolition and possession upheld; compensation decree by First Appellate Court set aside.
